verdict.rationale: Antigravity supports background autonomous execution via Scheduled Tasks (docs-2) and message scheduling while away (docs-39), and provides isolated background folders via native Git worktree support (docs-38), plus Remote Control to reach running sessions from a browser (docs-26). However, these are framed as local/desktop-session isolation (worktrees, machine sessions) rather than a managed cloud sandbox, and no evidence describes a dedicated cloud execution environment for offloading long-running tasks. missing for 10: explicit cloud-hosted/sandboxed execution environment (vs. local worktree isolation), evidence of task duration limits/reliability for long-running background jobs, and independent confirmation that background/scheduled tasks work as advertised.
